description: This file defines a custom authorization state provider for a Blazor application, managing user authentication state by fetching and caching user info from an API.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of AuthenticationStateProvider that manages user authentication state with caching, fetching user info from a web API, and updating the HttpClient authorization header.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to provide the current authentication state, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user, using cache if valid, otherwise fetching fresh data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Fetches user information from the web API and constructs a ClaimsPrincipal representing the authenticated user.
